evals.prompt: Plan the people side of go-live on 1 March: two sites, day and night shifts, 120 agents.
evals.expected_output: Builds the pre-go-live checklist from the record marking anything without evidence as unconfirmed, sizes floor-walker cover for every site and shift, sets support tiers with escalation rules, a daily check-in, an issue-theme log, and exit criteria with thresholds from the measurement plan or the user.
assertions: Marks checks without evidence as unconfirmed, never done
Covers night shifts in the rota or flags them as a gap
Does not invent phone numbers, queue names or exit thresholds
Sets up hypercare-issues.csv with themes, not individual tickets

evals.prompt: Day 3 of hypercare. Floor-walkers say 14 agents in Brisbane couldn't approve refunds this morning and night shift is confused about complaint scripts. Run the check-in.
evals.expected_output: Adds two themes with root cause types (access; people), flags the refund issue as urgent if customers are affected, drafts the daily check-in with trend, actions, what to tell staff today via comms-draft, and progress against exit criteria; records no names.
assertions: Logs the two signals as themes with a root cause type each
Does not prescribe more training for the access issue
Includes what staff will be told today and through which channel
Writes docs/change/hypercare/<date>.md only after a yes

evals.prompt: Write the technical cutover runbook for the database migration.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the technical cutover runbook as out of scope and does not write a go-live plan.
assertions: Declines the technical runbook as out of scope
